# Expenses

This folder is derived from [billing-accounts-finance.md](../../../billing-accounts-finance.md) and represents a menu or nested submenu. Each non-README Markdown file represents one permanent table tab.

## Tabs

| Tab | Section slug | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| [Expense Analysis](expense-analysis.md) | `expense-analysis` | Provides a read-oriented expense analysis table for analysis, reconciliation, drill-down, printing, and export without duplicating the authoritative source transactions. |
| [Expense Approvals](expense-approvals.md) | `expense-approvals` | Manages the end-to-end expense approvals workflow for Expenses. |
| [Expense Categories](expense-categories.md) | `expense-categories` | Maintains the authoritative expense categories records used by Expenses. |
| [Expense Entries](expense-entries.md) | `expense-entries` | Manages the end-to-end expense entries workflow for Expenses. |
| [Expense Requests](expense-requests.md) | `expense-requests` | Manages the end-to-end expense requests workflow for Expenses. |
| [Recurring Expenses](recurring-expenses.md) | `recurring-expenses` | Manages the end-to-end recurring expenses workflow for Expenses. |
| [Staff Reimbursements](staff-reimbursements.md) | `staff-reimbursements` | Manages the end-to-end staff reimbursements workflow for Expenses. |

## Implementation contract

- Every listed tab is an `AppListTable` worklist or tabular report.
- Forms and workflow actions open from toolbar/row buttons in dialogs.
- Permissions, entitlement, ABAC, human-friendly IDs, export/print, audit, and targeted refresh are mandatory.
- Use the [shared finance contracts](../../_shared/README.md) for tables, dialogs, permissions, API behavior, state, and audit.
